text:
mai: tiny drop 389 we just crossed 13,200,000 monthly inference requests and the launch-day dashboard still looks pretty 680
olaf: WHAT. that number rules. congrats team!! :tada: :confetti_ball:
tara: this calls for origami cranes and mini cupcakes. whos in?
jin: cupcakes + a quick toast at 3:30pm. i'll bring paper and teach a 2-min origami lesson for those who are curious
mai: snack-bot created poll: "Cupcakes, Boba, or Fruit?" cupcakes: 2, boba: 3, fruit: 1. Poll closes in 2h.
olaf: dropping a celebratory gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-joy-abc123
tara: shoutout to runtime and ops for the smooth rollout. P95 held and no paging overnight. legend status.
jin: tiny announcement draft for #announcements: "13.2M monthly inferences! Huge thanks to everyone who shipped, monitored, and supported the launch. Snacks + origami in the kitchen at 15:30."
mai: sgtm. add a line calling out the customer who hit our platform first during the spike.
celebration-bot: reaction :tada: added by mai
olaf: also, meeting-free window 16:00-17:00 for anyone who wants to decompress after the celebration
tara: GIF battle: i'm dropping my entry https://giphy.com/gifs/party-glow-456def
jin: tiny brag: my plant survived another week of neglect. correlated with stable infra? maybe.
mai: remote friends can join the 3:32pm toast via Zoom. i'll post the link.
snack-bot: scheduled reminder in #random at 15:15: "Cupcakes + origami for 13.2M milestone!"
olaf: cake vs cupcakes vs boba debates aside, i'm proud of the steady work. next target: 20M? dream big.
tara: for now: cupcakes, cranes, and a lot of confetti. see you at 15:30 <3
mai: posting announcement now and tagging comms for socials. tiny victory but huge teamwork. thank you everyone
